about: The epistola of the formulary “Sunday after Ascension” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Dearly beloved: Be prudent and watch in prayers. But before all things have a constant mutual charity among yourselves, for charity covereth a multitude of sins. Use hospitality one toward another without murmuring. As every man hath received grace, ministering the same one to another as good stewards of the manifold grace of God. If any man speak, let him speak as the words of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the power which God administereth, that in all things God may be honored through Jesus Christ our Lord.
